_comment: cr-starter is the ROOT of the fork family and has no parent, so this file
is the CANONICAL POLICY TEMPLATE rather than an operational sync config:
`make sync-parent` is not run here. Downstream repos (cr-auth-starter and
its forks) each carry their own .fork-sync.json with a real `parent` block,
but they should derive their policy.sync / policy.preserve from this one.
TWO POLICY INVARIANTS this template exists to lock in:
1. GENERATED OPENAPI CLIENT IS PRESERVED. frontend/lib/openapi-client/** is
generated code owned by each repo's own codegen, NOT parent-owned source.
It matches the frontend/lib/** sync glob, so it MUST be listed in
policy.preserve or a sync would clobber a fork's generated client. Every
downstream policy that syncs frontend/lib/** MUST also preserve it.
